name: Chef des terrasses
description: A large athletic olive-skinned mature male chief with dark marbled markings, a wide head, short backward-swept dreadlocks and four prominent mandibles. Navy cloak attached to one large carved-bone shoulder guard, dark sand long split robe and heavy bronze arm cuffs. One hand on his hip and the other carrying a compact bronze armillary clan symbol at belt height. Commanding but peaceful.
